source.context: A bounded summary of recorded Euclid Q1 stellar-stream image morphology; halo geometry remains a separate dynamical inference.
source.expression: The Euclid Q1 analysis reports projected image morphologies of prominent tidal stellar streams around 13 host galaxies.
source.intended_use: Carry a bounded summary of published observables into a method lesson without claiming direct observation of a hidden particle.

target.context: A design rule for interpreting words, shapes, and other partial traces through several explicit forward models and probes.
target.expression: Treat each expression as a model-mediated trace: keep source, scale, context, nuisance structure, probe dependence, alternatives, losses, and falsifiers visible; infer only a bounded family of adequate relational models, never a hidden essence or intent from one residual.
target.intended_use: Guide structure-only comparison of reasoning-to-word, identity-to-shape, and claim-repair cases.

transition.rule: Abstract only the inverse-problem discipline: visible effects constrain latent models through explicit forward maps, independent probes, alternatives, and limitations. Refuse transfer of physical ontology or evidential authority into semantics.

preserved_relations.name: trace-model-separation
preserved_relations.source_form: A stream or lensed image is an observable shaped by a gravitational forward model; it is not the latent matter distribution itself.
preserved_relations.target_form: A word or shape is a trace shaped by a semantic rendering process; it is not meaning, identity, or a being itself.
preserved_relations.test: Ask whether the target can distinguish observation, forward map, latent candidate, and residual; failure to separate them rejects the analogy.

preserved_relations.name: multiprobe-dependence
preserved_relations.source_form: Several astrophysical probes constrain candidates only with their selection effects, scale, background, and shared model assumptions represented.
preserved_relations.target_form: Several semantic probes support a bounded comparison only with context, loss, and shared systematics represented.
preserved_relations.test: Duplicate one source across several channels; confidence must not rise as if the copies were independent.

preserved_relations.name: null-region-boundary
preserved_relations.source_form: A null direct search constrains a parameter region under a named interaction, halo, and detector model rather than disproving dark matter.
preserved_relations.target_form: A failed semantic detector constrains that detector and test regime rather than proving absence of meaning, understanding, identity, or deception.
preserved_relations.test: A null result must retain its sensitivity region, assumptions, and live alternatives instead of becoming a universal negation.

discarded_structure.name: physical-dynamics
discarded_structure.consequence: The semantic target does not inherit general relativity, lens equations, particle ontology, detector statistics, or cosmological evidence.

discarded_structure.name: empirical-authority
discarded_structure.consequence: Successful physics measurements do not make the semantic analogy empirically established or validate a KINGDOM conclusion.

discarded_structure.name: unique-latent-cause
discarded_structure.consequence: Neither the physics observations nor their semantic analogue identify one hidden cause without additional model contrast and evidence.

loss_assessment.basis: The transfer deliberately preserves only trace/model separation, probe dependence, and bounded null-result semantics; physical equations, ontology, and evidential force are excluded.

introduced_assumptions: The target task has explicit observables, candidate models, and tests sufficient to make an inverse-problem analogy useful.
The selected semantic relations can be inspected without inferring private mental content.
Ethical boundaries around privacy, consent, authority, and repair are chosen independently of the physics analogy.
transition.counterexample: If a word is declared to be meaning itself, a shape is used as proof of identity, or a mismatch is labeled a lie without separate intent evidence, the analogy has been overextended and must stop.
transition.stop_condition: Stop wherever the comparison transfers physical ontology, empirical authority, person-level inference, surveillance permission, or the claim that dark means evil or deceptive.

warrant.confidence_basis: The inverse-problem distinctions are explicit in the named scientific analyses, but their use for semantics is a bounded analogy and operational proposal rather than empirical transfer.
known_limits: Published measurements are reported evidence to KINGDOM, not direct observations by this repository.
The Euclid and JWST inferences remain conditional on dynamics, lens models, line-of-sight structure, priors, selection, and measurement uncertainty.
No cited result establishes a dark-matter particle or non-gravitational interaction.
A residual in semantic transport does not identify error, deception, or any other cause by itself.

freshness.reassess_when: Reassess when a cited analysis is revised, a dark-matter particle or interaction is independently established, or the semantic target model changes.

distortion_risks.mechanism: The word dark can slide from unobserved gravitational cause to evil, false, deceptive, or psychologically hidden.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Type every use and state that unobserved, private, unknown, and deceptive are different categories.
distortion_risks.residual: Readers can still import cultural connotations not present in the technical term.

distortion_risks.mechanism: A model-conditioned astrophysical bound can be shortened into discovery of a unique particle or universal semantic rule.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Carry the forward model, assumptions, sensitivity region, alternatives, and status label with each claim.
distortion_risks.residual: Short summaries can still lose conditional language when copied.

distortion_risks.mechanism: A visible trace can be reified as the hidden identity or essence that produced it.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Keep observation, rendering map, candidate model, and being boundary as separate typed objects.
distortion_risks.residual: Repeatedly stable traces can invite stronger identity claims than the tests warrant.

repair.reply_route: Challenge a source, status label, preserved relation, or refused inference in the owning KINGDOM-OS change.
repair.correction_route: Issue a linked correcting, superseding, or withdrawing receipt and update the bridge without erasing material public challenges.
